5646.name: Mini Candy Crane Machine
5646.content:
![Mini Candy Crane Machine](/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/mini-candy-crane-splash.png)

**Arcooda's Mini Crane Machine is the perfect machine for a variety of settings such as bars, offices, waiting rooms, and most importantly homes! Being small and compact, the Mini Crane Machine can easily change between candy and mini plush prize options, giving the machine a fresh feel each time the prize is changed. It's illuminated lighting effects are sure to grab attention, while it's simple game play will have players coming back for more.**

**We can also work with operators to customise the machine for your specifications. From choosing different colours, themes, stickers, etc to customising the percentage payment algorithms to suit your venue, our team can work with you to get the perfect solution for you.**

![blank](/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/blank.png)



## See the Mini Candy Crane in Action

![](/wp-content/uploads/2020/12/crane-machine.jpg)

**Operators can easily change a variety of arcade settings such as claw strength, gameplay, and music and simply in the menu. The Mini Crane Machine also features the ability to switch between coin operated and free play, making it great for both commercial venues and for families at home. **
